UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF APPLIED MANAGEMENT SCIENCES
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF PROJECT COORDINATOR
Project: Socio-Psychological Impacts of Drug Addiction on the Wives of the Addicts: A
Study of Doaba Region in Punjab
Sponsoring Agency: National Commission for Women, New Delhi
Designation: Project Coordinator (01)
Requirements for Project Coordinator
Essential: - Applicants are required to have Master’s Degree or a higher degree (M. Phil/ Ph.
D) in Law/ Social Work/ Human Rights/ Management with at least 55% marks (or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from an Indian
University.
Desirable: Experience in data collection, data entry and analysis through SPSS, report
writing, etc. Candidate must be well versed with the research methodology.
Work Description: Prospective Project Coordinator is required to assist in the project work,
field visits, data collection and analysis using statistical techniques.
Honorarium: Project Coordinator is entitled to Rs. 18,000/ per month (Fixed).
Duration: The duration shall be of 9 months or till the completion of the project whichever is
earlier. The Project Coordinator may be terminated even before (with one week notice if the
work is not found satisfactory).
Domain for Data Collection: Punjab (Jalandhar, Kapurthala, Nawanshahr)
How to apply
Applications on plain paper giving following details must reach the undersigned by May
6, 2023.
Full Bio-data including name, parents name, postal address, email and mobile number along
with academic details starting from 10th onwards and experience as well as supporting
documents.
Application as a single PDF file can also be sent by email to monikaa@pu.ac.in
Hard copy can be brought at the time of interview, in case application is sent through email.
(Monika Aggarwal)
Professor and Principal Investigator of the Project
University Institute of Applied Management Sciences
